headline: Executive order directing federal agencies to work with other countries on regulations.
what_it_does: This order is about international cooperation on regulations. Based on its title, it tells federal agencies to coordinate with foreign governments when making rules. No summary was provided, so the specific requirements and steps cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to take international cooperation into account when developing rules.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses that operate or trade in more than one country
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected if US rules are coordinated with the rules of other countries.
